name: Spectrum and Edge-based Gaussian Splat Count Estimation
aliases: Geometric complexity measurement for Gaussian splats
definition: Determines the expected number of 3D Gaussian splats per semantic group by analyzing image spectral complexity and edge energy to control geometric detail.
summary: This method estimates Gaussian splat counts by analyzing image spectral complexity and edge energy, outperforming naive frequency statistics by isolating high-frequency geometric details via Canny edge detection.
